actions.action: Check for root-bound signs (roots out of drainage hole, water running through, soil drying in 1–2 days)
Repot into a pot 2–5 cm wider with drainage hole, using potting mix plus one-third perlite or orchid bark, keeping swollen root at same height
Loosen circling roots and snip off dead or mushy roots during repot
Check top 2–3 cm of soil and water when dry
Keep out of harsh direct sun for about 2 weeks after repot
Optionally trim the tall shoot back to 2–3 leaves
Feed with half-strength houseplant fertilizer monthly in spring and summer
